title: Assign research from the newsroom and run it without a terminal
description: Newsroom action on a Story page: "Assign research", a textarea for the editor's direction and a button, no dropdowns, Lucide icon. Creates the same Assignment as `papyrus stories assign-research` and shows it in the Work trail with its state. A worker runs open `research.multi` assignments linked to a Story without someone at a terminal. Likely a router task, may need IAM grants, which need Ryan's explicit yes. UX gets screenshot review before merge. Shape depends on the live test on the facial-recognition Story.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Ryan 2026-11-03 approved building this. Three parts, one PR into develop per part if that is simpler, all held for screenshot review before the UI merges.

PART 1, BOX. On the Story page (`components/newsroom-article-editor.tsx`, near the Work section of `components/story-reporting-trail.tsx`), an "Assign research" action: a textarea for the editor's direction and one button, Lucide icon, no dropdowns, flat rounded backgrounds, no outlines, not colour alone. It works at every stage. It does the same as `papyrus stories assign-research`: type `research.multi`, `contextProfile: reporter`, `itemLineageId`, the Story's section, the default title from the Story, status open, an AssignmentEvent, and a Story at `idea` moves to `assignment` through the existing recorded move. TRAP: the Assignment model has no `metadata` or `instructions` columns. Metadata including `direction` goes to a ModelAttachment; the pack reads it through `assignment_metadata`. PR 1110 was a live bug from this. The browser path must end with the same stored shape as the CLI, proved by a test that builds the pack from what the browser path writes. See how `components/topic-steering-workspace.tsx` and `create-story-button.tsx` create records and attachments. Editor and admin only. Empty direction is refused in the UI.

PART 2, SHOW. The Work section shows each research assignment: direction, state (waiting, running, finished, failed, with the failure reason), when, and its packet: summary, recommended angle, claims each with links to its cited sources, disagreements, open questions, and an "Could not verify" list when `unverifiedClaims` is present (another agent is adding that; render it when present and don't depend on it). Packet metadata is a ModelAttachment on the Message linked by the `produces` relation. Keep it private to the newsroom. Do not add these to any Message thread: Messages come only from people.

PART 3, WORKER. A router task `research-assignments`, in `monitoring_router.py` following `suggest-backlog`, with its own lock and its own schedule, finds open `research.multi` assignments that have a Story and profile `reporter`, per publication, oldest first, marks running through existing assignment events and runs `research_multi` within the Lambda time. A search takes minutes, so stop before the deadline and leave the rest. An assignment left running past its time is failed with a reason so it can't hang. A person asked for this, so no budget gating beyond the existing spend alarm. Check the Lambda has the search and model keys, S3 access for attachments, and `corpora/` not required. Read `docs/monitoring-cloud.md`. List exactly which IAM grants and template changes this needs. DO NOT deploy: prepare the template and tell me; IAM changes need Ryan's explicit yes.

SPECS. Gherkin for each behaviour, TypeScript tests where the repo does for components. Docs: `docs/story-reporting.md`, and add a p.apyr.us docs ticket note per the docs rule. Screenshots: run the local preview with `scripts/dev-local-preview.mjs` or the repo's documented path, take desktop and phone screenshots of the box empty, the box with text, each assignment state and a finished packet with synthetic content. Do not merge. No production writes.
